source_ref.note: Audited source is a detached git worktree of main at 9805d91 (after refactor PRs #11-#14) in the parent's scratchpad; agents read it and sbx mounts it read-only at /target. Only docs/security-audit/run-4/ (this run's output) is added on the working branch.

budget_note: Owner-set cap of 50 agent invocations (standard profile). Plan: 4 reconnaissance, one hunter wave, one post-wave critic, one distinct final-clean critic, and the rest reserved for Phase 3 and Phase 5 verifiers. Model split as in run-3: Opus for recon, hunters, Phase 3 and critics; Sonnet for Phase 5 record verifiers; Opus for material-replacement re-verifiers.
execution_note: Agent-run target code runs only through tools/sbx: docker run --network none --read-only, host /usr and the audited worktree read-only, writes only to agents/<id>/scratch (a 256 MiB loop-mounted ext4 per agent), /dev/shm tmpfs 16 MiB, --pull never, jinja2/markupsafe mounted read-only, uid 65534, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, 512 MiB, 1 CPU, 64 pids, 32 MiB file size, 120 s, explicit env allowlist. Checks that need the real Docker-backed control plane are run by the parent with dummy principals in a scratch AGENTBOX_HOME on loopback inside this disposable cloud container (labelled parent-live). Promotion uses tools/promote.py.
